name: How long does it take for mold to grow in wet carpet after a leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for mold to grow in wet carpet after a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can begin to grow on wet carpet and padding within 24 to 48 hours, especially in warm, humid conditions. This rapid growth timeframe makes quick action critical for effective remediation. If the carpet remains wet for more than 48 hours, the likelihood of significant mold development increases, requiring more extensive and costly removal procedures. Professional water extraction and drying services are essential to prevent mold, as they use specialized equipment to thoroughly dry all affected materials before mold has a chance to establish itself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can start growing in wet carpet within 24 to 48 hours after a leak. Prompt professional drying is essential to prevent its development.
